faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the HP EliteBook x360 830 G7 and G8 — it does not fit the standard (non-x360) EliteBook 830 G7/G8. The part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker on your battery on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.
